sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Deterministic validation is invalid because the COMPLEX_READINESS dependency contract requires operand nltl:extremeIceForce, which is absent. Add the canonical nltl:extremeIceForce property on the required ship owner, with a required QUDT quantity value in http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloN and one xsd:decimal qudt:numericValue, while retaining the existing load-case alternatives, shaftLineLoadCaseTypeValue class constraints, loadCase-owned componentYieldSafetyFactor checks, and shipComponent-owned fatigueSafetyFactor checks with their exact cardinalities.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows:
Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: COMPLEX_READINESS applicability evidence(s) absent from candidate: shaftLineLoadCaseTypeValue
Semantic validator feedback: Add the missing canonical term nltl:shaftLineLoadCaseTypeValue as explicit applicability evidence: constrain each nltl:shaftLineLoadCaseType value node with sh:class nltl:shaftLineLoadCaseTypeValue while retaining the allowed controlled alternatives. This term is required by the COMPLETE dependency contract and its absence causes deterministicValidation.valid=false; the vocabulary matcher is activated to locate the scoped canonical term.

The required shaft-component ownership is still wrong. nltl:fatigueSafetyFactor has requiredOwner shipComponent, but the candidate constrains it on nltl:propellerShaftLineComponent nodes reached via nltl:hasPropellerShaftLineComponent; those nodes are not the declared owner. Use the supplied nltl:hasComponent path from the ship to shipComponent and place the fatigueSafetyFactor constraint on that shipComponent owner, while retaining the propeller shaft-line component relationship only where needed to identify the regulated components and avoiding duplicate fatigue facts. The previously requested nltl:shaftLineLoadCaseTypeValue class constraint is present and should be retained.

Retain the canonical shaftLineLoadCaseTypeValue class constraint and the fatigueSafetyFactor path through ship nltl:hasComponent to shipComponent. Repair the fatigue direct check so it cannot pass when a component has an additional invalid or duplicate fatigueSafetyFactor: require each applicable component to have exactly one q:QuantityValue factor with exactly one xsd:decimal q:numericValue, unit UNITLESS, and value >= 1.5, and assert the factor’s q:QuantityValue class. Also add maxCount 1 to the applicable componentYieldSafetyFactor and shaftLineLoadCaseType properties and to their q:numericValue properties so alternative checks cannot succeed by selecting one valid value among duplicates.

Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: COMPLEX_READINESS required input(s) absent from candidate: extremeIceForce
Semantic validator feedback: Deterministic validation is invalid because the COMPLEX_READINESS dependency contract requires operand nltl:extremeIceForce, which is absent. Add the canonical nltl:extremeIceForce property on the required ship owner, with a required QUDT quantity value in http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloN and one xsd:decimal qudt:numericValue, while retaining the existing load-case alternatives, shaftLineLoadCaseTypeValue class constraints, loadCase-owned componentYieldSafetyFactor checks, and shipComponent-owned fatigueSafetyFactor checks with their exact cardinalities.
